title: The semantic hinge
synthesis: A new, page-free semantic hinge turns separate bounded type spaces into an articulated type-instance comparison and then a broad, three-part relation aperture. The selected complete subject-verb-object statement persists through inspection and outcome. Source provenance stays attached while an actually empty human-review field remains separate from it. Geometry and line patterns communicate identity, relation role and proposed applicability without relying on color or motion.

contributions.O1: Reworks bounded type territories as five clean, cut-edge regions and reuses the precise instance diamond inside an explicitly labeled instance region. Rejects contour geography because it does not encode an engineering quantity or relation.
contributions.O2: Reworks the whole source-relation-target ribbon as one broad central aperture between two bounded semantic regions. Solid input, dashed proposed application and double support strokes survive monochrome reading. Rejects decorative background crossings and incomplete inactive relations with omitted endpoints.
contributions.O3: Reworks separate strata as a source area and an empty human reviewed-as field below the retained statement. Uses proposed and pending wording rather than a verdict; no green success or fabricated verification appears. Rejects dark extruded bars and geological survey detail so the result does not resemble P&ID layers.
contributions.O4: Reworks the type-instance spread into an actual geometric hinge: the right instance wing scales out from the shared central axis while the type wing remains distinct. The instance-of arrow connects Pump A back to Pump. A plain context margin preserves selection without false clickable tabs. Rejects the cabinet, paper leaves and brass hardware to keep TBE's documentary identity separate.
contributions.O5: Reworks ordered subject, named relation and object disclosure inside a single broad aperture rather than the original stepped typographic page. Retains large words and explicit pending status, and improves downstream continuity by retaining the chosen statement and source through review and outcome instead of resetting to equipment.

new_composition: Five cut-edge semantic regions open into a two-wing type/instance hinge, then a broad sentence aperture. Review separates source support from an empty verdict area, and outcome retains identity above the selected aperture with source and unresolved human review below. This is neither O1's terrain map, O2's woven horizontal loom, O3's dark slab stack, O4's cabinet nor O5's diagonal composing stick. Its articulated hinge, bounded sentence geometry and persistent empty-review boundary are newly composed together.
interaction: Equipment selects the proposed Head balance applies to Pump A relation; Method selects Head balance requires input Flow condition; Evidence selects Head balance supported by Reference excerpt. The selected region, context label, complete sentence, relation edge pattern and accessible description update deterministically. The context choice remains visible in all five phases and the chosen complete statement stays in phases 2, 3 and 4. A context choice changes emphasis only, never the authored facts or pending applicability.
limitations: All terms and relations are authored illustrative examples from the public brief. Reference excerpt is a visibly retained illustrative source label, not an invented publication, retrieved citation or performed source validation.
The human review field is deliberately empty. No engineering calculation, applicability assessment, approval or recorded human verdict is claimed.

Only the selected relation is enlarged; inactive relation fragments are omitted rather than shown without named endpoints. The five type vocabulary and explicit Pump/Pump A distinction remain separate teaching phases.
Primary terms use 30-46 SVG units and secondary text uses 24 units; fixed-viewBox artwork still requires the root agent's actual 320px mobile and bilingual browser inspection.

Motion is finite, with the final source and review appearance finishing at 3.5 seconds. Unanimated and reduced-motion states show the complete composition. Static validation does not substitute for animation playback, assistive-technology or human comprehension testing.
